stimulus.body: Port registry note (dedicated to the public domain): Numbers from 0 to 1023 are reserved for well-known services. Numbers from 1024 to 49151 are set aside for registered uses, which is 48128 numbers. Numbers from 49152 to 65535 are for dynamic assignment, which is 16384 numbers.
